purpose: Offline descriptive analysis of existing evaluation query tensors; no receiver, denoiser, training or new physical scenes.
error: saved query minus saved normalized effective truth channel
metrics: For each axis: uncentered 16x16 mode Gram using other 256 entries; offdiagonal squared Frobenius fraction, diagonal CV, largest eigenvalue fraction. Antenna 4x4 UPA unitary DFT; output/input ordinary 16-point DFT. All bases fixed before this analysis, none learned.
limitations: Mode Grams are single-query uncentered second moments, not estimates with 256 independent samples or identified ensemble covariance.
Existing cases are evaluation traces, including a failure-enriched group. Use only for exploratory diagnosis; do not fit a training covariance law or report new receiver performance.
All user entries are dependent within scenes; summary quantiles are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Three marginal mode Grams do not identify full covariance or establish a separable covariance model.
Signal projection is descriptive and conditioned on final failures where indicated, not an identified conditional gain.

white_control.law: Independent proper complex unit-variance Gaussian, no per-realization normalization; finite-sample Gram reference only, not receiver performance.
